Canada.headline: TSX climbs 0.5% on financials, healthcare & tech gains, lower oil prices and political stability
Canada.why: Financial stocks lifted the index, while healthcare and technology shares also rose. A drop in oil prices helped lower bond yields, and the rejection of Alberta's separation referendum removed a political risk, all contributing to the market's advance.
